name: Endings, landmarks and their quest chains, wave 1
notes: docs/CONTENT.md section 13. Eight endings (haven_settle, haven_exodus, haven_lure, wayout_concord, wayout_clans, wayout_lumen, hollow_truth, retire), the Haven chain (10 events, 2 of them Hollow lures, plus 4 pages), the Way Out x3 (backing, core, restart), the Hollow thread into the Scrapper Gate (8 events), Retire, and the 6 landmarks (anomaly_haven_ghost_first, station_ma_in_person, wreck_field_cs001_patience, gate_inside_the_shell, station_lumen_first_gate_study, empty_hollow_node_survived). Needs the effects unlock, ending and the event key landmark. gate_alloy comes from engines_1; gate_core and hollow_kettle are in this pack's items.json. Placement is by `requires.region` and `stage_min` / `stage_max` and flags (stages 1 to 8, the ending region is stage 9): the Haven trail is stages 2 to 7 (first fragment 2 to 5, then each link a stage later, the bearings 6 to 8, the Reach from 6 on), the Way Out is backed at a faction station (Meridian in concord_space 3 to 6; the Clan Moot at any station of basalt_quarries, gauntling_scrapyards or kett_hives 3 to 7; the Prism in lumen_space 4 to 8) and finished at the Dead Gates of the ending region (stage 9), and the Hollow thread runs from stage 3 (the green ship) to the Scrapper Gate (stage 9), its last fragments from stage 5 and 6 on, so they can also happen in the Gate approaches. Retire and Ma's dinner stay at Rusthold, so in clan_space. Events of type gate name their gate in requires.node (gate_1 Concord, gate_2 Scrapper, gate_3 Lumen); the Dead Gates can be approached in the ending region only (campaign.gd gate_dark); the lure events are the same carrier type as the real fragment they replace (haven_3 wreck_field, haven_5 distress).
